$comment: P4.73 — the corpus + seed spec for `images_routes_equivalence` (the /api/v1/images COLLECTION route). Ids are pinned so both differential sides read byte-identical rows; only the ingest/generate mutations mint fresh ids, which the harness canonicalizes. NOTE: `$`-prefixed keys are the ONLY comment form this file may carry, and never inside a case map (memory note `corpus-comment-inside-a-case-map-is-parsed-as-a-case`).
$profiles: The generate leg's connection profiles: PROFILE_MAIN is the default (not dangerous-compatible), PROFILE_UNCENSORED is the AUTO_ROUTE reroute target, PROFILE_NOIMAGE names a provider with no image capability (the `<provider> provider does not support image generation` refusal).
$chatSettings: One row per user (v4 chatSettings is per-user via findByUserId). The corpus flips the stored dangerousContent bag per case with `settingsPatch` rather than seeding a second user.
